title: feat(skills): publish the skills catalog as @objectstack/skills in the fixed group
body:
Part of #22658
Clause-②: no

Ruling A on #22649 (record 6096124407, maintainer 「22649 同意 A」): the published skills catalog ships as a versioned package in the changeset `fixed` group. This is PR 1 of the two the card allows — the package. PR 2 (`claude/issue-22658-compat-line-derived`, Tier H) derives the frontmatter lines; the cli and devx halves (#22659, #22668) remain open and consume what this PR publishes.

## What this adds

- `packages/skills/` — a new publishable package `@objectstack/skills` (version 17.7.0, the fixed group's; `publishConfig.access: public`; `files: dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md`; `exports` names only `./package.json`, the `@objectstack/console` shape for a package with no JS entry). No second copy of a skill is committed and nothing is symlinked: `dist/` is gitignored and produced by the build.
- `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` — the build: wipe `dist/`, copy the repository root's `skills/**` into `dist/skills/**`, read the copy back and refuse to finish unless the two trees are equal file for file and byte for byte; `--check` runs that same comparison and is the package's `prepack`, so `pnpm pack` / `pnpm publish` refuse a stale or absent tree; `--self-test` (nine batteries over temp fixtures: byte equality, idempotence, a deleted source file not surviving a rebuild, byte change / extra file / missing file / absent tree each red, an empty catalog refused, a symlink refused rather than followed) runs as the first leg of the package's `build`, the `--self-test && run` idiom every `check:*` alias uses, so it is never dormant and needs no new gate.
- `.changeset/config.json` — `@objectstack/skills` joins the `fixed` group (70 members); `.changeset/22658-skills-package.md` — `minor` for the new package, plus a `patch` line for `@objectstack/spec` because `packages/spec/llms.txt` (a published file) counts the scoped packages and `check:llms-txt` moved it 68 → 69.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` — the new importer (`packages/skills: {}`), as `pnpm install` writes it; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is untouched (`packages/*` already covers it).

## Why `dist/skills/`, measured

`skills@1.7.2`'s `experimental_sync` discovers a dependency's skills at exactly two places, read from its `discoverPackageSkills`: `PKG/skills/NAME/SKILL.md` and `PKG/dist/skills/NAME/SKILL.md`. Of the two, `dist/` is the one this repository already treats as a build output everywhere: canonical in `files` for `check:published-files` (no EXTRA_ENTRIES row), gitignored repo-wide, turbo's default `outputs`, and skipped by the directory walk of `check:published-readme-exports` / `check:published-readme-links` — a copy at `PKG/skills/` would have put all 53 catalog markdown files into those two gates' published-markdown population whenever a build had run, so their verdict would have depended on local build state. The sibling cards wrote `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/skills/*` before this measurement; the path they consume is `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills/NAME/`.

## Tarball and consumer measurement (the card's Done-when)

`pnpm pack` from `packages/skills` on the built tree: `prepack` ran `--check` (65 files byte-identical), tarball `objectstack-skills-17.7.0.tgz`, 68 entries — 65 under `package/dist/skills/` (10 `SKILL.md`, 21 references, 18 rules, 15 evals, the catalog README) plus `package.json`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`. Installed in a throwaway project outside the repository (`npm install --save-dev FILE.tgz`), then `npx -y skills@latest experimental_sync --yes --agent claude-code`:

- `Found 10 skills in node_modules`, each listed as `NAME from @objectstack/skills`;
- wrote `.agents/skills/NAME` as a symlink to `../../node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills/NAME` and `.claude/skills/NAME` as a symlink to `../../.agents/skills/NAME`; 64 files reachable through `.claude/skills` (65 minus the catalog README, which is not a skill); `diff -r` of `.agents/skills/objectstack-data` against the package copy: identical;
- `skills-lock.json` records each skill with `source: @objectstack/skills`, `sourceType: node_modules`, `skillPath: dist/skills/NAME/SKILL.md`, `version: 17.7.0`.

So the sync fits the layout; `--copy` copies instead of linking. The cli card can use the sync as is.

## Every gate that must learn a no-JS package, through its declared path

- `check:type-check-coverage` — an EXEMPT ledger row beside `@objectstack/console` (no TypeScript sources, no tsconfig).
- `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:lean-entry-closure` — nothing declared: the populations are derived (a built package whose manifest declares no declaration path owes none; no `require` entry, no `.map`, no lean entry). Measured on the fully built tree: `check-dts-closure: 1 built package(s) declare no declaration entry point and owe none` on the package alone, and all four green over the 73-task build.
- `check:published-files` — `dist` + README + CHANGELOG are canonical; `exports` present (70 publishable packages, census floor 50).
- `check-published-list-mirrors` does not fit (it mirrors a constant into AGENTS.md), so byte equality is proven by the copy step's self-test, as the card allows.
- `turbo.json` — `@objectstack/skills#build` declares `$TURBO_ROOT$/skills/**` as an input (otherwise an edit under `skills/**` is a cache hit replaying a stale copy, remote cache included). Probe on this tree: one byte appended to `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` → `cache miss, executing aca937c23b400d14`; restored to HEAD (blob equal, `git diff HEAD` empty) → `cache hit, replaying logs 47fea834c3a0ce5a`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — the `core:` filter gains `skills/**`, because `check-ci-filter-parity` requires every `$TURBO_ROOT$` build input to be covered there (`OK: all 21 build input(s) … covered by core`). Its self-test pins the live `crosspkg` rollback count over the LIVE table on purpose; with `core` now covering the skills root the rollback uncovers 19 instead of 22, and the pin moved with the tree (the two by-name assertions now assert coverage through `core`), recorded in its comment.
- `check:lockstep-package-count --fix` — the three prose restatements of the group's size (two in `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`, one in `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs`'s header) 69 → 70; `check:llms-txt` — `packages/spec/llms.txt` 68 → 69 (the gate's own remedy: the number and the prose).

`pnpm changeset status`: `@objectstack/skills` is listed among the 70 fixed-group packages to be bumped, at the group's pending level (`major`, from the v18 stock already on `main`).

## Gates run (exit codes captured before any pipe)

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the changed set and reconciled with `--ran`: 140 derived, 140 run, 0 UNRUN. All exit 0 except two prerequisite refusals (exit 3, NOT MEASURED, neither reads this diff's surface): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs an unshallow clone) and, before the build, `check:docs-transcript-drift` (needs `@objectstack/lint` built — green after the build). Highlights: `check:published-files`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:ci-filter-parity` (+ self-test, 131 assertions), `check:changeset-fixed` (70 public packages in sync), `check:lockstep-package-count`, `check:llms-txt`, `check:published-readme-links` (102 published markdown files), `check:published-readme-exports`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:merge-driver`, the three changeset gates against `origin/main`, spec `check:docs` / `check:skill-examples` (262 prose examples type-check), `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier: 1825 cases pass; 6 slow sections deferred to CI). Full workspace build under the verify lock: 73 tasks successful, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 350s.

Lint, narrowed and measured at `3372d78b1`: eslint over the four JavaScript files this PR touches (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`, `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs`) — `--format json`: 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population: `eslint.config.mjs` judges `.`; invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (its own note: no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file; the repo-wide run is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The README's sentence that `npm create objectstack` and the docs read the catalog from this package describes the ruling's end state; #22659 and #22668 are the halves that make it true and are not addressed here.
- `metadata.version` and the `compatibility:` majors are untouched here; PR 2 derives them.
- `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs`'s header digit moved, which schedules the advisory `OS Create Smoke` workflow on this PR.
- A new published package skeleton has no recent precedent in this repository (the card says so); `@objectstack/console` is the nearest shape and was copied for the manifest.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- 改了什么:新增发布包 `@objectstack/skills`,构建时把仓库根目录的 `skills/**` 原样复制进 `dist/skills/`,进 changeset `fixed` 组,版本号恒等于 `@objectstack/spec`。`skills/**` 本身不动、不搬、不做符号链接。
- 为什么改:今天装 17.7.0 的项目从仓库 `main` 取技能,拿到的是在教 v18 写法的文本;发成包以后,装哪个版本就拿哪个版本的技能(已用打包 + `npx skills experimental_sync` 实测:10 个技能全部从 `node_modules` 装入)。
- 风险与代价(含回滚):多一个发布包;`fixed` 组从 69 变 70,三处文案计数与 `llms.txt` 的计数随之改动。回滚 = 从 `fixed` 组移除并删掉目录,其余文件不受影响。
- 席位意见:(留空)
- 你要做的:这张 PR 不是受管面,走队列即可;你要批的是第二张(十个 SKILL.md 的两行派生)。
